description: Memory access fixture, phase 3 section 5.5: 40 records of two owners across six access shapes, three classes, three project labels, four authorities, sessions and flags. The suite writes record n with id mem-<n+1 as 24 hex digits>, recorded at the suite's base instant plus n seconds, and checks every read path against an independent oracle for three readers.
